text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-123456 - inference-gateway-eu-west1 > 3% 5xx over 2m. Auto-page triggered. https://redwood.pagerduty.com/alerts/PD-1234 :rotating_light:

mia_oncall: acked. Mia (oncall) here — looking now. 

olivia_sre: pinging @javier_router and @sam_night_oncall — any recent deploys/rollouts in eu-west1? :eyes:

javier_router: not a deploy from me in last hour. seeing lots of TLS handshake errors in sidecar logs on gateway pods in eu-west1. sample:```
2026-03-15T21:12:03Z sidecar[pid=1234] WARN TLS renegotiation failed: short read
2026-03-15T21:12:04Z upstream=10.4.3.12:443 error=response status=502 body="upstream read error"
```

mia_oncall: ran a quick curl from a jumpbox:```
curl -v https://gateway-eu-west1.redwood.internal/health
* Connected to gateway-eu-west1.redwood.internal (10.4.3.5) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.2 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* SSL connection using TLSv1.2 / ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: gateway-eu-west1.redwood.internal
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"upstream read error"}
```

support_pmg: support is seeing a spike in tickets from EU customers (AcmeCorp, PaperTrail) starting ~21:10 UTC. Estimated impacted sessions ~2-3% of traffic. I'm drafting comms. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia_sre: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/gateway-5xx. Immediate options: 1) rollback last sidecar config change (if any), 2) route a % of traffic to eu-west2 fallback, 3) restart affected sidecars. Prefer safe routing fallback while we triage.

javier_router: starting controlled traffic shift to fallback region (eu-west2) at 30% for gateway service. executing:```
# redwood-router v2 CLI
redwood-router set-weight --service gateway --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --percent 30 --reason "mitigation: 502 surge"
# response
OK: routing weights updated, change-id=chg-89b2
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-123456 acknowledged by mia_oncall. If not resolved in 15m will escalate to L2.

mia_oncall: monitoring metrics and logs, increasing fallback to 50% if error rate doesn't drop in next 5m. will collect sidecar logs and cert/openssl versions. @sam_night_oncall please standby for handoff at 00:30 UTC if still open. :thumbsup:

sam_night_oncall: standing by. if you cutover more than 50% loop me in and i'll pick up continuity. leaving calendar note.

javier_router: pulling node info -> found sidecars with openssl 1.0.2 on some older nodes that had cert rotation last night. command:```
kubectl get pods -l app=gateway -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.spec.containers[0].image}\n' | grep sidecar
# rolling restart for subset
kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n infra --selector=zone=eu-west1-old -o name
```
Rolling restart started for 10% of nodes in eu-west1-old group. will watch for TLS errors to reduce. :construction:

support_pmg: comms update drafted and ready for approval. ETA 30m to send to impacted customers with brief note + mitigation steps.

olivia_sre: temporary tweak to alerting: disabling duplicate auto-page rule for this symptom to reduce noise while we test failover. Path: Console -> Alerts -> inference-gateway-5xx -> Edit -> suppress-duplicate 10m. do we want that?
mia_oncall: yes please, do it. we were getting repeated PD storms. 

javier_router: error rate dropped from 3.6% -> 0.9% after 30% shift and first restart. metrics:```
- 21:10 5xx rate 3.6%
- 21:22 shift to eu-west2 30%
- 21:30 restart 10% nodes
- 21:35 5xx rate 0.8%
```

incident-bot: PD note: INC-123456 status=acknowledged, responders: mia_oncall, javier_router, olivia_sre. Auto-escalation suppressed per runbook change.

mia_oncall: errors are back to baseline across EU. increasing monitoring retention for 60m to ensure stability. starting a follow-up ticket for sidecar cert rotation gaps + node image upgrades. creating TICKET-4572. :white_check_mark:

support_pmg: sending approved customer note now. will follow-up with affected accounts directly.

sam_night_oncall: taking handoff at 00:30 UTC if still open; otherwise i'll follow the follow-up ticket in the morning. thanks all. :handshake:

olivia_sre: post-incident actions: collect sidecar logs, list nodes with old openssl, schedule rolling upgrade for eu-west1-old pool, update runbook with cert-rotation checklist. assigning owners in TICKET-4572.

mia_oncall: closing this thread — incident resolved, will run retrospective tomorrow. great coordination. :rocket:
